evidence: X-ray diﬀraction spectra of all ﬁlms showed no reﬂections, suggesting either amorphous ﬁlms or oxidation of the titanium before the analyses could be conducted. AFM images of 82 nm thick ﬁlms grown at 140 °C had rms surface roughnesses of 1.3 −4.9 nm, indicating smooth surfaces. XPS analyses of a 76 nm thick titanium ﬁlm grown at 180 °C were very similar to the 140 °C ﬁlm, except that the impurity levels were slightly lower.
